title: Modrite Fire Sprinkler system test Aug 2026
description: In the Modrite Fire, a unique high-pressure, large scale hoselay and sprinkler system was deployed on road systems north of the fire. The 10-inch hose was placed in areas near Twin Lakes with large sprinkler attachments and pumps. The system was set up as an emergency, contingency plan in case the fire moves past the containment line.
